tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Look up geolocation (continent, country, region, city, coordinates, timezone, EU status, and ASN) for a single public IPv4 or IPv6 address.

tools.name: my_location
tools.description: Look up geolocation (continent, country, region, city, coordinates, timezone, EU status, and ASN) for the caller's own public IP address as seen by the API.

tools.name: lookup_batch
tools.description: Look up geolocation for up to 100 public IPv4 or IPv6 addresses in one call. All IPs are validated before charging quota; each IP in a valid batch counts as one lookup.
